reason: A Windows dsh plugin that performs local OCR on attached images and converts them to text for text-only models, with optional vision-model passthrough.

summaries.zh: 在 Windows 上使用系统 OCR 将 dsh 会话中的图片附件转换为文本，供仅支持文本的模型使用。
summaries.en: Uses Windows OCR to convert image attachments in dsh sessions into text for text-only models.

capabilities: Reads attached image files from the local dsh attachment store
Runs Windows OCR through a PowerShell script
Rewrites image content blocks into OCR text before model requests
Can optionally forward original image bytes when passthrough is enabled
